name: Red wine
description: Grapes fermented on their skins, often aged in oak for years.

tcm.note: Wine is warm and blood-moving in the Chinese reading.

ayurveda.note: Madya is ushna and tikshna in a high degree — among the most pitta-provoking substances named.

unani.note: Garam-khushk; well documented in the classical record, whatever the religious position on drinking it.

histamine.note: The textbook histamine trigger: skin-contact fermentation, ageing, sulphites, and alcohol blocking DAO all at once. Red is worse than white.

effects.note: Alcohol measurably slows reaction time and narrows attention at ordinary drinking doses, well before intoxication feels subjectively obvious — one of the most consistently replicated findings in pharmacology, and the reason legal drink-driving limits exist at all. A standard glass delivers enough to produce it. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
